name: Basra

queries.query: بصرة خريطة عقارية دائرة التسجيل العقاري GIS العراق
queries.scope: Find an official Basra land-registry map with anonymous full parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official Iraq MOJ published a Basra Directorate of Real Estate Registration notice describing local staff training on its system for lodging and checking property reservations/obstacles, confirming a city-specific registry process. Basra Municipality’s Building Permit Division public page requires ownership deed Form 25 and a current boundary-fixing map (valid three months) for new applications; status lookup asks for an application form number. The governorate’s archived interactive map shell has no embedded cadastral feature service. No anonymous parcel polygon was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: Arabic search and read-only inspection of Ministry of Justice, governorate map archive, and municipality service sources.

queries.query: Basra Iraq official cadastral map parcels land registry GIS public map
queries.scope: Cross-check official land-map e-services and public city map availability.
queries.result: The same primary city-specific MOJ record confirms the Basra real-estate registration directorate. The municipality’s permit form is specific to Basra, requires an ownership deed and boundary map, and provides login by application number for case follow-up. The MOJ electronic title/map request article is a separate Baghdad-only rollout and is not treated as a Basra public service. No anonymous parcel feature endpoint is exposed.
queries.executionMethod: English search with direct inspection of official Iraq MOJ and Basra municipality/governorate pages.

portals.name: Iraq Ministry of Justice property-map e-service
portals.operator: Ministry of Justice, Government of Iraq
portals.observation: National MOJ article documents property-map/deed e-services, but its published rollout is selected Baghdad directorates only. This is not counted as Basra public geometry; Basra-local registry evidence is supplied separately.

portals.name: Basra Governorate interactive map archive
portals.observation: Archive page shell is reachable but no embedded public parcel map or feature-service URL is present.

portals.name: Basra Municipality land and permit services
portals.observation: The official Basra Building Permit Division new-application page requires a property ownership deed (Form 25), boundary-fixing map current within three months, and approved building plans; the login form follows an application number for status checks. This is a city-specific parcel-document procedure, not an anonymous cadastral data portal.

portals.name: Basra Directorate of Real Estate Registration (MOJ)
portals.operator: Ministry of Justice, Government of Iraq
portals.observation: Official MOJ article dated 14 May 2024 identifies the Basra Directorate and its internal procedure for recording/consulting property reservations and encumbrances; this confirms city-specific property-registration records, not an open public map.

requests.observation: Archive shell returned HTTP 200; inspection found no iframe or parcel feature endpoint in the page.
Official building-permit portal is identified by municipal service sources; its parcel/map workflow uses login and application/transaction context, not an anonymous public feature query.
Official MOJ article titled “Basra Real Estate Registration Directorate organizes a workshop on reservations/obstacles management” identifies the local directorate and its property-record workflow.

Official Basra Municipality Building Permit Division page shows new registration and application-number login; its new application requires title deed Form 25 and a boundary-fixing map whose validity is limited to three months. No parcel map/vector data is returned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Basra land-registration and municipal permit workflows are evidenced locally by MOJ and the Basra Municipality Building Permit Division.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-specific registry and parcel-document procedures are confirmed, but neither source exposes a public anonymous parcel layer. No full geometry at the WUP point was obtained.

technicalBlocker: Basra public sources document title/registry processing and municipality-required boundary maps, but no anonymous full-polygon viewer or vector feature endpoint was found. Municipality status lookup is application-number based.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Basra registration directorate has a public map viewer or a data-request pathway for full parcel geometry, and whether WUP-center parcel coverage exists.
nextStep: Ask the Basra Directorate of Real Estate Registration or municipality for a public parcel map/feature service and test a bounded full-geometry response; do not infer geometry from the required boundary-map documents.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: City-specific primary evidence: Iraq MOJ article documents the Basra Real Estate Registration Directorate and its local registry procedure for recording reservations/obstacles in property records; Basra Municipality’s Building Permit Division requires an ownership deed (Form 25) and a current boundary-fixing map. These prove city land-registration/parcel-record workflows, but not an anonymous public parcel layer.
